title: kv-surge-tightener-and-sticky-egress-hedge-hotfix
author: Priya Desai
release_notes: Hotfix: reduce probability of regional egress stalls during KV cache pressure. Introduces an egress governor with hysteresis, stronger telemetry tagging for circuit decisions, and a short-lived feature flag for gradual rollout.
description: Motivation: During a multilane KV cache pressure event we observed entire regional egress paths being tripped by aggressive circuit decisions. This caused visible host-side backpressure and extended degraded windows for customers in affected regions. This PR introduces a short-term hotfix that narrows the conditions that cause immediate regional egress cutover and adds an ephemeral egress governor that caps burst egress while allowing sticky rejoin attempts with exponential backoff and metric-anchored safety. What this changes: - Introduces pkg/runtime/egress_guard.go: egress governor implementing a token-bucket cap per-region with hysteresis and a short cool-down window. - Adds pkg/scheduler/kv_pressure_handler.go tweaks to expose a graded pressure signal (pressure_score) instead of binary pressure, used by the guard. - Adds feature flag deploy/featureflags.yaml: egress_guard_v2 toggles the new behavior for canary rollout. - Adds tests: pkg/runtime/egress_guard_test.go and integration/regional_rejoin_test.yaml exercise rejoin semantics and KV-pressure-induced slowdowns. - Observability: docs/observability/egress-guard.md plus added telemetry tags on circuit events so SLO-enforcer and console traces can correlate. Rollout plan: - Enable feature flag for 5% of traffic in us-west-2 for 24h. - Monitor metric egress_guard.fail_rate, region_egress_retries, and slo.latency_p95. - If stable, expand to 25% then full. Rollback plan: flip egress_guard_v2 to false (instant). Also a control-plane kill switch introduced for emergency 0s fallback. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for governor logic - [x] Integration test simulating KV surge and verifying graceful partial shed - [x] Telemetry tags added + dashboard note - [x] Canary rollout + automated alert thresholds added - [x] Post-merge smoke runbook appended Testing notes: Local unit tests added and passing. Integration test ran in staging with synthetic KV pressure profile and showed 60% reduction in full-region circuit flips; 95th latency impact within SLO slack. The description below contains the full list of commits, changed files, CI results, reviewer discussion, and merge details.

motivation: Reduce cascade failures from KV pressure by making egress decisions graded and observable instead of binary; buy time for longer-term eviction/refill strategies.
impact_summary: Staging injection showed a 60% drop in full-region circuit flips and reduced incident MTTR. No customers reported increased latency beyond configured SLO slack during canary.
